summary: CarGurus, Inc. filed an 8-K on August 6, 2026, covering two items: entry into a First Amendment to its existing Credit Agreement and announcement of Q2 2026 financial results. The amendment reduces revolving commitments from $400.0 million to $200.0 million, extends maturity from September 2027 to August 2031, increases the Cash-Capped Incremental Facility cap, and adds an incurrence-based leverage covenant (max 6.25:1.00). This is a routine credit facility amendment, not a special-situation transaction. The 8-K also furnishes earnings results. No M&A, activist, tender, spin-off, or restructuring activity is present. The filing is a standard operational update. Watch only for future strategic actions enabled by increased financial flexibility.
